acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

approve(address,uint256).details: Gives permission to `to` to transfer `tokenId` token to another account. The approval is cleared when the token is transferred. Only a single account can be approved at a time, so approving the zero address clears previous approvals. Requirements: - The caller must own the token or be an approved operator. - `tokenId` must exist. Emits an {Approval} event.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the number of tokens in ``owner``'s account.

buyListed(uint256,uint256).details: Deletes the listing before either USDC interaction. No approval or receiver callback is needed. Show closure does not restrict resale; resale buyers receive no rewards. Reverts before any transfers if the listing price exceeds maxPrice.

buyTickets(uint8,uint16[]).details: The cap is tickets currently held per wallet and show, including resale and plain ERC-721 transfers. Upgrades leave current holdings unchanged. Validate the holdings cap before pulling USDC, then mint and update holdings only after payment. Duplicate detection uses a bounded two-word memory bitmap; both loops have at most six iterations.

params.initialOwner: Initial administrator; cannot be zero and cannot renounce ownership.
params.usdc_: Trusted six-decimal USDC ERC-20 contract, not a native-token payment path.

getApproved(uint256).details: Returns the account approved for `tokenId` token. Requirements: - `tokenId` must exist.

getSoldBitmap(uint8).details: Word zero covers seats 0..255. Bits 88..255 of word one are always zero.

isApprovedForAll(address,address).details: Returns if the `operator` is allowed to manage all of the assets of `owner`. See {setApprovalForAll}

listForSale(uint256,uint256).details: Listing is permitted while paused or while its show is closed. Re-listing replaces the old listing.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

ownerOf(uint256).details: Returns the owner of the `tokenId` token. Requirements: - `tokenId` must exist.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256.details: Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`, checking first that contract recipients are aware of the ERC-721 protocol to prevent tokens from being forever locked. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must have been allowed to move this token by either {approve} or   {setApprovalForAll}. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon   a safe transfer. Emits a {Transfer} event.

Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon   a safe transfer. Emits a {Transfer} event.

setApprovalForAll(address,bool).details: Approve or remove `operator` as an operator for the caller. Operators can call {transferFrom} or {safeTransferFrom} for any token owned by the caller. Requirements: - The `operator` cannot be the address zero. Emits an {ApprovalForAll} event.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

tokenURI(uint256).details: Show is the human-readable day (1 or 2); Seat is the original zero-based seat ID.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`. WARNING: Note that the caller is responsible to confirm that the recipient is capable of receiving ERC-721 or else they may be permanently lost. Usage of {safeTransferFrom} prevents loss, though the caller must understand this adds an external call which potentially creates a reentrancy vulnerability. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}. Emits a {Transfer} event.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

upgradeSeat(uint256,uint16).details: Pays the primary-price difference before burning/minting. The old seat becomes available again. Rewards increase only by the points difference. Tier-zero upgrades add one historical VIP acquisition. Tickets currently held per show and previously earned lightsticks remain unchanged.

buyLightstick(uint256).notice: Buys one to ten virtual lightsticks and earns 25 points per unit.

buyListed(uint256,uint256).notice: Purchases a listing, paying the seller 95% and the contract a 5% fee, rounded down.

buyTickets(uint8,uint16[]).notice: Buys one to six available seats for a show.

cancelListing(uint256).notice: Cancels a listing as its seller or the current ticket owner, even while paused.

decodeTokenId(uint256).notice: Decodes a structurally valid ticket ID; does not require a currently minted ticket.

fanCount().notice: Returns the number of distinct addresses that have earned rewards.

getFans(uint256,uint256).notice: Returns a clamped page of registered fans in first-earned order, not point order.

getListing(uint256).notice: Returns the current non-escrow listing, or zero fields if there is none.

getSoldBitmap(uint8).notice: Bit i in the concatenated two words indicates that seat i is currently minted.

listForSale(uint256,uint256).notice: Lists an owned ticket at any positive USDC price without escrow or approval.

pause().notice: Pauses only purchase, resale purchase, upgrade and lightstick purchase operations.

pointsOf(uint8).notice: Returns historical reward points for acquiring a seat in a tier.

priceOf(uint8).notice: Returns the primary price in six-decimal USDC units.

renounceOwnership().notice: Always reverts to preserve an administrator for revenue and pause controls.

setShowOpen(uint8,bool).notice: Sets primary-sale/upgrade availability for a show; does not restrict transfers or resale.

ticketsHeld(uint8,address).notice: Tickets currently held per show/holder, capped at six.

tierOf(uint16).notice: Returns tier 0 for seats 0..239, tier 1 for 240..319, or tier 2 for 320..343.
